name: GA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +27 partisan lean
Incumbent Hank Johnson running for reelection
Polymarket prices Johnson at 98% to win
Republican challenger James Duffie has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The district's +27 Democratic lean, Johnson's incumbency, and a 98% market price all point to a comfortable Democratic hold, with no polling or ratings suggesting any competitive threat. The Republican challenger's lack of reported fundraising reinforces the lopsided picture.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending targeting the district would be the first sign the race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 4th District is a heavily Democratic Atlanta-area seat, and incumbent Hank Johnson is seeking another term after easily winning renomination. His Republican challenger, James Duffie, has reported no fundraising, while Johnson has raised over $400,000 and holds cash on hand. Prediction markets give Johnson roughly a 98% chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive.

With no general-election polling available, the outlook rests on the district's strong Democratic fundamentals, which point to a margin in the high twenties. Barring an unforeseen shift, this seat is expected to remain safely in Democratic hands in November.
